svg.text: FM-index loci in the suffix tree
Text bananabananabandanas$, BWT snnnnbbdbn$aanaaaaaaa. Backward search reads the pattern from right to left;
the final suffix-array interval is the set of leaves below the marked locus (diamond); those leaves are framed in the same colour.
nabx: the first letter read is x, which is not in the text, so the interval is empty at once and there is no locus.
